article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 23 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Dick Orkin's Chickenman, A Cavalcade of Kings, and Smilin' Ed's Aladdin's Lamp

sec.title: Batch 55 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 55 resolves 23 historical radio broadcasts spanning 1960s satirical pop serials, 1930s royal biographical docudramas, and early 1930s acoustic variety programming: 7 classic episodes from Dick Orkin's celebrated Chicago comedy superhero satire ***Chickenman*** ("The Wonderful White-Winged Weekend Warrior", 1966), 8 episodes from the 1938 British historical dramatization series ***A Cavalcade of Kings*** (covering the reigns of William the Conqueror, Edward III, Richard II, Richard III, Henry IV, Elizabeth I, Charles II, and James II), and 8 vintage 1932 musical variety shows from Smilin' Ed McConnell's ***Aladdin's Lamp***.
